reviews.title: You.com is so underrated
reviews.pros:
I’ve been using You.com for a while now, and I have to say, it’s awesome. The ability to customize my search experience and get summarized results instead of just links saves me so much time. It feels like having a personal assistant built into my browser.

One of the biggest pros is the AI-powered summaries and direct answers. Unlike traditional search engines, You.com actually understands context and provides useful insights without making me click through a dozen pages. The privacy-focused approach is also a huge plus. I don’t feel like I’m being tracked or bombarded with ads based on my searches.

The interface is clean and modern, making it easy to navigate. I also love how I can choose different modes, whether I want a balanced search, AI-generated responses, or a developer-focused view. It’s flexible in a way that Google just isn’t.
reviews.cons: Everything has been great for me. I don't have any issues with You.com.
reviews.overall: Overall, I highly recommend You.com for anyone looking for a smarter, more private, and AI-enhanced search experience. It’s refreshing to see innovation in search, and I can’t wait to see how it evolves. Considering upgrading to You.com Pro.
